title: Decoding an encoded pair
statement: For every natural number $n$ and Boolean words $u,w$, remove the leading run of $1$s and the next two bits from the encoding of the pair whose first component is $1^n$ and whose second component is the encoding of $(u,w)$. Decoding the remaining word returns $(u,w)$.
